adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy, the function executes `fetch(...)` and returns the raw Fetch `Response`. In the Zoho Bigin caller (`packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`), the return value is treated as an Axios response (`tokenInfo.data.error`), and in Zoho CRM (`packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`) it is also treated as Axios (`zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`, `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.expiryDate`). Under the sync-enabled path, these `.data` accesses will be undefined and can cause misbehavior/crashes. The diff clearly introduces this mismatch.
